paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi, as evaluated on the WMT15 De dataset. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 0.0 to 10.0 and is marked with intervals of 2.5, representing the average lagging of the translation process. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 18 to 28 with major gridlines at intervals of 2, indicating the quality of the translation output. The plot shows four distinct lines: Consistency-CE (light purple, circle markers, dotted line) starts at a BLEU of approximately 19.0 and increases to about 24.5; Inconsistency-CE (dark purple, square markers, solid line) begins at around 20.0 and rises to approximately 27.0; Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue, square markers, dashed line) starts at 18.5 and reaches about 27.2; and Consistency-Bi (red, star markers, solid line) starts at 22.5 and increases to a peak of 29.0 at an AL of 9.0 before slightly decreasing to 28.5 at AL 10.0. All models show an increasing trend in BLEU score as average lagging increases, with the Consistency-Bi model achieving the highest BLEU scores across the entire range.
